nodes.name: IMAP: ticket@spw-ai.com
nodes.notes:
IMAP trigger against ticket@spw-ai.com on Plesk mail server. Fires whenever a new unread message lands (plus-addressed replies from clients: ticket+ID.hmac@spw-ai.com).

After import: click this node, open Credentials, select the mail.spw-ai.com IMAP credential you already created.

nodes.name: Normalize fields
nodes.notes: Coerces to/from into simple strings the API expects. Handles both string and array-of-object formats since n8n's Email Trigger output shape differs by version.

nodes.name: POST to SPW API
nodes.notes: Posts the normalized email JSON to SPM's InboundEmailController. Auth is a bearer token that must match INBOUND_EMAIL_SECRET in the API's prod .env. Retry 3x on network/5xx failure so a temporarily-down API doesn't lose messages.
